        stem.append((a,b))
        visited.add(a); visited.add(b)
        a+=1; b-=1
    stems.append(stem)

# The small hairpins are kissing each other across the multiloop because the loop
# facing each stem's closing pairs is complementary (GCGC repeats). To break the

for si,s in enumerate(stems):

    seqs=[]

            seqs.append('A')  # AU at ends (weaker)
        else:

        seqs=['C' if k%2==0 else 'G' for k in range(L)]
        seqs[0]='A'; seqs[-1]='U'
    if si%3==2:
        seqs=['G' if k%2==0 else 'C' for k in range(L)]
        seqs[0]='U'; seqs[-1]='A'

        seq[b]=comp[seqs[k]]
